title: File:Interior of Coventry Cathedral, 15 November 1940 - John Piper - 1940.jpg
desc: Interior of Coventry Cathedral, from sketches made on 15 November 1940, the day after its destruction in an air raid.

title: File:Coventry Cathedral after the air raid in 1940.jpg
desc: The ruined nave and chancel of Coventry Cathedral, England, seen from the west tower. It is in ruins after the German air raid of November 1940.

title: File:Coventry Cathedral, November 1940.jpg
desc: Inside the ruined nave of Coventry Cathedral, looking northwest. The foreground is littered with bricks, girders and rubble. On the left is the west tower. Centre right in the distance are the tower and spire of Holy Trinity parish church.

title: File:Winston Churchill at Coventry Cathedral cph.3a18421.jpg
desc: Prime Minister Winston Churchill walks with the Mayor of Coventry and a member of the Church of England clergy through the ruined nave of Coventry Cathedral after it was bombed by the German air force in November 1940. Official war photograph for the UK government.

title: File:Ruins of the old Coventry Cathedral - sculpture - Ecce Homo (13818174003).jpg
art: Elliott Brown from Birmingham, United Kingdom
desc:
One of the main reasons of visiting Coventry was to check out the ruins of the old Coventry Cathedral!
It was bombed during the Blitz of Coventry in November 1940.
The ruins are Grade I listed.

Sculpture - Ecce Homo by Sir Jacob Epstein

title: File:Reconciliation by Vasconcellos, Coventry.jpg
desc:
The sculpture Reconciliation by Vasconcellos showing two former enemies embracing each other. It was erected in 1995 in the north aisle of the ruins of St Michael's Cathedral, Coventry. (Destroyed during fire bombs during the Coventry Blitz on 14 November 1940).
The text on the pedestal is in Englis
